about: Light shards (the XP, GAME_DESIGN 7): sprites and effects. Generated by cast/shards.py.
palette: core.PAL (20 colours), every pixel exact and opaque or transparent
units: pixels at 320x180; origin = the pixel of the frame that sits on the anchor point

shard_small.note: Pop and hover. Frame 0 is the still pose. Add the bob in code (hover.bob_px at hover.bob_hz).

pull_small.rows: 16 directions: row d faces angle d*22.5 deg (0 = +x right, clockwise, +y down)
pull_small.note: While pulled: row = the shard's travel direction (the Bezier tangent). Trail pixels in code.

shard_medium.note: Pop and hover. Frame 0 is the still pose. Add the bob in code (hover.bob_px at hover.bob_hz).

pull_medium.rows: 16 directions: row d faces angle d*22.5 deg (0 = +x right, clockwise, +y down)
pull_medium.note: While pulled: row = the shard's travel direction (the Bezier tangent). Trail pixels in code.

shard_large.note: Pop and hover. Frame 0 is the still pose. Add the bob in code (hover.bob_px at hover.bob_hz).

pull_large.rows: 16 directions: row d faces angle d*22.5 deg (0 = +x right, clockwise, +y down)
pull_large.note: While pulled: row = the shard's travel direction (the Bezier tangent). Trail pixels in code.

shard_pop.note: Once per kill, at enemy.centre(), as the shards fly out.

drink.note: A shard lands. Frame 2 is the glass's one-frame cream flash.

drink_large.note: A large shard or the star lands. Frame 3 is the cream flash.

merge.note: A new shard merges into the newest waiting one (queue cap): play on the waiting shard.

ready_pulse.note: Fill >= 0.8: once per beat (144 BPM), 80 ms.

lantern_full.note: The gauge fills (with the lantern_full sound).

trail.note: 1 px each, at the shard's positions 20, 40 and 60 ms earlier

star.note: Size 3 draws the magpie's own star (magpie.json effects star_held / star_fly).
